why: Jellyfin 12 disabled the legacy X-Emby-Token header by default, so every Jellyfin integration request returned HTTP 401.
acceptance_criteria: Jellyfin requests use the Authorization: MediaBrowser header and never send X-Emby-Token.
Jellyfin status, scheduled tasks, and library refresh succeed against Jellyfin 12.x and 10.8+ servers.
The full source matrix, including Windows, source updater build, and compiled Windows smoke tests pass.
v0.5.165 publishes source and Windows updater packages with SHA-256 digests.
decisions: Use only the standard Authorization header rather than also sending legacy headers, so the integration does not depend on Jellyfin's EnableLegacyAuthorization setting.
out_of_scope: No changes to other integrations, authentication modes, or updater behavior in this release.
next_action: Run full validation and Windows packaging; if green, publish and verify the complete updater-visible v0.5.165 release.
